summary: This topic covers the process of logging into the ERP system using OTP, setting up a password, and navigating to the Academics module.
steps: Log in using your phone number via OTP.
Optionally, set your password after logging in.
Optionally, change your password using the 'send OTP to change password' feature.
Once logged in, click the 'Settings icon'.
Select 'Academics' to proceed with academic configurations.
important_notes: Initial login is performed using a phone number and OTP.
Users have the option to set or change their password after the initial login.
questions: How do I log in to the ERP system?
